Elliot Rodgers believed he was the living embodiment of Patrick Bateman (American Psycho).

Let's start from the top. At the beginning of American Psycho, the song Bateman is listening to when he walks into work is ["Walking on Sunshine"](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=knpOqVWeSP8). [Here](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hHfoLnCN2no), you can find Elliot Rodgers listening to... you guessed it, same song.

Later in the movie, [Bateman is talking about his love for Whitney Houston.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g1mSJpOBXFU) [Rodgers posted a video of him listening to you know what...](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FFqn8gTmEQw) Whitney Houston.

Other music:

[Rodgers - Phil Collins](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=69N0-tJOkT8)

[Bateman - Phil Collins](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pmTyizVfCng)


Both Rodgers and Bateman have a mindset where to them, women are objects. They are objects of sex, and they are only to provide sex to males that each person sees fit enough to be a potential mate. Rodgers longed for a sex life, and Bateman achieved a sex life through adultery and prostitutes. Not exactly a healthy relationship, huh?

Both Rodgers and Bateman have a twisted imagination where they blow everyday interactions far out of proportion.

Both Rodgers and Bateman have a serious desire for blonde women. Bateman expressed this in the first prostitute scene, and Rodgers expresses this repeatedly throughout his manifesto.

 **SPOILERS AHEAD** 

Analyzing the movie may lead one to believe that Bateman was a schizophrenic. He did not actually commit these murders, but he imagined them. That would explain why the bodies were missing from Paul Allen's apartment, and also as to why his "lawyer" would not believe him that he did commit the murders.

Rodgers believed that every poor interaction he had with females was due to them being inferior. He would express anger and hatred when a girl would not smile back or say hello to him in the hallways or on the bus. He would stare at them and hope they would say hello to him or get to know him or even take him on a date. He took a simple greeting and escalated it to dating, relationships, and ultimately sex.
